paragraphs: In Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, folio 173b, R’ Nehemiah Dipu asks before R’ Tanchum bar Chama in the name of R’ Sima. Hyman suggests that he may be R’ Nachman Dipu. See that entry.

notes.text: The source locator is קעג: (173 with a colon); its edition and pagination remain to be checked. The identification with Nachman Dipu is Hyman’s tentative suggestion.

The locator קעג: remains literal and edition-dependent. Earlier finite research did not locate the connected Tanchum/Sima passage; its Seder HaDorot snippet reports another chain and is not a substitute. Pesikta de-Rav Kahana is the contextual work expansion, not a verified folio mapping. No exact full personal-title witness is bound for these four abbreviated occurrences, so they remain R'. Hyman’s perhaps-identification with Nachman Dipu stays tentative; no place or person binding is made.

Buber’s edition of Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, folio 173b (Acharei Mot), explicitly names Nehemiah Dipu as the one asking, Tanchum bar Chama as the one asked, and Sima as the source of the teaching. Buber’s notes 116–117 report a Yudan Dipu reading, several readings with Pinchas bar Chama, and omissions in other witnesses. Hyman’s proposed identification with Nachman Dipu remains tentative.
